interview.name: Vik
interview.answer: I don’t have the confirmed time or location yet.

reflections: Vik is a steady organizer who keeps the group aligned and delegates clearly.
Cleo is dependable and supportive, handling preparation without needing much prompting.
Oren is willing to help but needs explicit reminders and simple task breakdowns to stay on track.
Vik is coordinating a neighborhood repair effort and depends on others to help distribute the plan.
Oren wants to help but needs simple, repeated reminders and concrete task assignment to stay on track.
Ira is cooperative and willing to help by keeping an eye out while running errands, fitting into the broader support network.
Oren is dependable but needs occasional reminders to stay on task and keep track of the supplies.
Vik is coordinating the neighborhood effort by repeating the plan, delegating coverage, and keeping people informed.
Mina and Ira are supporting the repair drive through outreach and by looking for missing details while running errands.
Vik is coordinating the group by repeating a short, clear repair drive plan so nearby people stay informed.
Mina and Tess are handling information gathering by checking on dates, times, and needed parts, then passing updates along.
The group is collaborating cleanly with simple role division: one person spreads the plan, others collect details and report back.
Vik is the main coordinator, repeatedly relaying the repair drive plan and keeping nearby folks informed.
Tess and Nell are still gathering logistics, especially the confirmed time and supply/needs list, and prefer updates as soon as details are solid.
Leo is contributing a parts update and values concise, clear communication, which Vik adjusts to.

events.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to everyone nearby.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll make sure the supply list is ready if anyone needs it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Vik: Great, I’ll let folks know about the plan and point them to your supply list.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring the tools by, but I’m a bit all over the place today. What do you need me to help with?
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll just go over the list again and we can split it up. If you can bring the tools, that’ll cover a big part of it.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll grab the tools and swing by soon. Just give me a reminder if I start wandering off again.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Oren: Yeah, I’ve got the tools in mind — just remind me what’s still on the list, and I’ll help where I can.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll run through the list again and tell everyone nearby to split it up. If you bring the tools, that’ll cover a big piece of it.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and keep an ear out for the list. If I drift off, just nudge me back on track.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Ira: That’s good to hear — I’ll keep an eye out for anything you still need while I’m out running errands.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the neighborhood and send folks your way if I spot anything missing.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Ira: Sounds good — just send them my way, and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Mina: I haven’t heard a date yet, but I can ask around for the times and what they still need.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — keep asking around, and I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to folks nearby so everyone stays in the loop.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll check for the date and the needs list, then I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Tess: I’m still checking on the times and what they need, but I’ll pass along anything solid as soon as I hear it.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to folks nearby, and you can send along the times and needs when you’ve got them.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep asking around and send you the times and any extra needs as soon as I get them.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to folks nearby so everyone stays in the loop.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. Keep it short and clear, and I’ll send the parts update once I’ve got everything together.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep it short and clear, and I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to folks nearby.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Nell: I’m still piecing together the updates—do you have the confirmed time and what they still need for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and the exact needs, but I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan to folks nearby once I’ve got them.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m still hearing it second-hand too, so just send it along when you’ve got the confirmed time and supply list.
events.speaker: Nell
